rationale: The Latin anchors *abigere* ("to drive away, expel") and *repudiare* ("to reject, cast off, repudiate") strongly point to a sense of getting rid of / casting away rather than physical throwing or molding. Among the candidates, *shed.v.01* ("get rid of") best captures this dismissive, expulsive sense attested in the Old English usage of *a-hwettan*.
